about: Where the code rig rigs/humanoid.js (H.solve of the pose tools/bake-person-side.mjs codePose gives, at its dimensions D0) puts the joints of every frame of every clip of base:person-side, and the torso the baker built from them (trunkOf): hips, neck, head, both legs' hip, knee and ankle, both arms' shoulder, elbow and hand, the held thing's angle `item`, `headTurn`, the trunk's angle and length. Recorded 2026-11-21 before R2b deleted the rig, for tests/unit/pieces-person-side.test.mjs, which holds the base's bones to them. Keyed '<clip> <frame>'.
